_comment: Minimal bundle — for Raspberry Pi and low-disk installs. All sizes verified from download.kiwix.org 2026-05. Total ~4.7 GB ZIM.
name: minimal
description: WikiMed medical reference (1.4 GB) and iFixit repair guides (3.3 GB). ~4.7 GB ZIM total — verified. Sized for Raspberry Pi with a USB SSD.

hardware.notes: ZIM total is ~4.7 GB (verified). Add ~2-4 GB for a small AI model (e.g. qwen2.5:3b). Pi 4 with 4 GB RAM can run qwen2.5:3b; 8 GB RAM is recommended for the 7B model.

model.name: qwen2.5:3b
model.notes: Smallest viable model for 4 GB Pi. Slower and less capable than 7B but fits in constrained RAM with headroom for the OS.
